name: 温和不刺激净脱脱毛膏款
description: 温和净脱不留粗根、膏体细腻易涂抹、用前斑贴提醒

styleLock.direction: clean gentle body-care commerce with a botanical-violet signature
styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for the packshot, pale lavender field #EDE9F7 for info and comparison shots, deep ink-purple #2E2A3E reserved for pain-point and closing panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: linen-washed stone counter #C9C2B8 and matte ceramic dish, matte paper panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one weight family, headline plus short labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded blank badge circles, single violet accent #8778C8
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright tube angle and scale across the set, product never covered by props
noDrift: no model faces or recognizable body identity
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent gentle body-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale lavender #EDE9F7, violet accent #8778C8, deep ink-purple #2E2A3E, warm off-white #F5F2FA and clean white #FFFFFF; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with rounded blank badge circles; clean high-end body-care photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright tube angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首图干净合规，一眼看清脱毛膏管身
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible and uncut by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the tube. Seamless pure #FFFFFF background. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial body-care e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no model, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no QR code, no membership badge, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达温和净脱的核心利益，承接点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle with a gentle upward camera tilt, product placed left of center
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle accent glow from the right, soft contact shadow
shots.background: pale lavender field #EDE9F7 with one vertical pleated paper panel in #F5F2FA behind the product
shots.props: one blank notched badge circle in #8778C8 at the upper right, one pleated paper panel, nothing else
shots.whitespace: clean empty band across the top 25% for the headline
shots.textZone: top-left headline zone carrying 「{selling_point_1}」 and a short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」

The product shown at a slight 3/4 angle with a gentle upward camera tilt, placed left of center, occupying 50-60%. shots.intent: 放大反复刮剃带来的泛红粗糙困扰，引出膏体方案

shots.lighting: left panel heavier directional light for tension, right panel soft even light
shots.background: left panel deep ink-purple #2E2A3E, right panel pale lavender #EDE9F7
shots.textZone: one short label per panel, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{selling_point_3}」 on the right
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen with two matched panels shot straight-on with identical framing. Left panel on deep ink-purple #2E2A3E: an abstract close-up swatch of rough bumpy skin texture rendered as a neutral material study, no person shown, under heavier directional light conveying post-shave irritation. Right panel on pale lavender #EDE9F7: {product} upright in soft even light as the resolving answer. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One short label per panel: 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{selling_point_3}」 on the right in clean sans-serif. The subject occupies 50-60% per panel. shots.lighting: skimming light from the right revealing fine cream texture, controlled highlight

shots.props: one shallow matte ceramic dish holding a smooth cream swatch
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject

Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp, skimming light from the right revealing the fine texture with one controlled highlight. Matte ceramic dish #C9C2B8 on a warm off-white field #F5F2FA. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1紫白竖条纹+泡泡装饰首屏，「温和脱毛膏天然安全」大字与三件紫蓝渐变瓶管；屏2深紫底「温和脱毛不刺激」加两枚橙色圆形角标（不伤肌肤/不留根部）；屏3白底「长效脱毛 抵制生长」加化学溶解毛发说明段与真人模特腋下/比基尼/大腿圆框特写；屏4紫色圆角卡「脱毛原理」与「三重保护不伤肤」三卡；屏5三张紫卡（天然精华/毛孔吸收/美白肌肤）与「比专业更专业」男女双栏灰色占位图；屏6男女双栏灰色占位格续接与「修复肌肤细化毛孔」加真人腰腹图；屏7「产品信息」参数表（规格/保质期/许可号/使用事项）加会员促销角标与二维码。品类判定：详情页品名明确为脱毛膏，属毛发移除类身体护理品，非着色彩妆，故判 护肤个护/身体护理，与源夹名美妆方向不同，以图内硬证据（品名、使用部位示意、膏体形态）为准。已剥离：原品牌字标与瓶身英文标签、真人模特全部人像与身体身份（改为抽象材质分屏与空白 proof 框）、橙色促销角标、会员加入提示、二维码、原文案原句、规格/保质期/许可号等全部数值（一律换 {callout_n} 或空白占位），功效断言（长效抵制生长、美白、细化毛孔等）不作为事实写入。与库内近似模版差异：1) 色板全新——浅雾紫 #EDE9F7/藤紫 #8778C8/墨紫 #2E2A3E/杏白暖底 #F5F2FA 均未在护肤个护任一登记套出现，替代该段拥挤的蓝白与青瓷体系；2) 背景体系不同——竖向褶纸屏风面板+实底紫场+深墨紫分屏，登记段未见褶纸屏风与实底紫场；3) 道具体系不同—— blanks notched badge circle + 空白 proof 圆角框 + 亚麻石台面 #C9C2B8 陶瓷碟，不复用登记段的大理石柱/金色拱环/冰块/水花/绿植球体等；4) 机位体系不同——采用 gentle upward tilt、flat lay 90 度俯拍、high 45 度俯角收口组合，避开登记段高频的 matched-split + extreme-close 组合节奏；5) 角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>DETAIL>SCENE>COMPARISON>TRUST>CTA 与段内已登记序列均不相同。温度取 neutral 时靠上述差异区分。
